## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks you ran. For IINA behavior, include the tested
IINA version and relevant open/seek/pause/track-selection steps.

## Compatibility

Mention changes to installation, dependencies, cache profiles, or the local protocol.
Keep private paths, recordings, generated caches and credentials out of the diff.
